subject: [PATCH 6.18.y] fs/proc/task_mmu: fix PAGEMAP_SCAN written state for unpopulated ptes

reviews.author: Sasha Levin
reviews.summary: Queued the patch for 6.18 without any issues or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Aug 05, 2026 at 02:43:52PM +0100, Kiryl Shutsemau wrote:
> Report pte_none as written in pagemap_page_category() too.  A pte_none
> carries no uffd-wp marker, i.e.  it is not write-protected -- the same
> condition under which the present and swap cases already report
> PAGE_IS_WRITTEN.

Queued for 6.18, thanks.

-- 
Thanks,
Sasha

2026-08-06.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in PAGEMAP_SCAN, where unpopulated ptes were reported differently depending on the path taken by the request. The fix involves reporting pte_none as written in pagemap_page_category() to maintain consistency and prevent issues with incremental-dump consumers.
